baseline_start.scope: Stop re-export surface historical scans only on proven complete-cache name misses; retain older same-name surfaces, partial fallback, shared-tail conservatism and invalidation.

adoption.scope: Compiler-sized flat wall improves 2.4449% (all five paired trials faster) versus A/A +0.5989%; FS cold median improves 2.2996%. No FS-warm or general package speedup claim.
adoption.summary: Complete-cache absence bounds reduce compiler-sized wall time while preserving historical surface semantics. Large-input allocation and all controlled reserved capacities are unchanged. Default CI allocation rises by 3112 B (about 0.0003%).
adoption.uncertainty: Original optimizer-cold and revised optimizer/parser-warm concerns prompted source-order refinement and six-pair follow-ups. Package wall effects remain inconclusive; preserve all initial/revised/follow-up observations and large first-pair negative outliers. Warm optimizer/parser execute zero surface queries, ruling out direct query-call overhead for those runs.
adoption.heap_baseline_action: retain 1019539416 and +10% tolerance; no upward ratchet or memory saving claim
